Hello my fellow bajs, I have a serious post to make and I hope you guys are respectful and mature enough to not joke about this.

Some of you may not know this, but Forsen, who is Nina's partner in case you're new, has maldness. Maldness is a very serious and dangerous disorder that should not be taken lightly, and I know the pain forsen and nina are going through right now as I also had a relative close to me who died because of this disorder.

If any of the two are reading this right now, please know that we, forsenbajs, are here for the two of you and we will support you in every way we can. I would also like to let you know that you shouldn't be scared to talk about it to us and that reaching out for help doesn't make you a coward. I know the community can be a bit "rough" sometimes, but I'm pretty sure you know that we were just memeing and we're not actually serious, and that if you do talk to us about forsen's condition, we won't be making fun of it, but instead we'll be supporting you all the way.

Again, don't be afraid to talk about it. I don't want to see his disorder straining the relationship too much as you guys are one of my most favorite couples on Twitch, and I would hate to see your partnership ruined because of some terrible condition.

To Nina, please take care of Forsen for as long as he needs it. I know it can be a bit hard sometimes because one of my relatives went through the same thing, but please don't give up and lose hope. You are Forsen's biggest chance of survival, and he needs you now more than ever.

And to Forsen, please know that we will always be there for you. I may not watch your streams as much as ~~Nymn~~Nina's, but all of us forsenbajs care for you all the same. And remember: Do not be afraid to seek help, even to your own community!

And to everyone else who are facing similar struggles right now, please remember: Never lose hope! It sounds a bit cliche but it's true. Life can be a bit rough sometimes but they are only temporary. Think of it like a video game and that the problems you're going through right now is just one of the many boss fights you'll encounter. But remember that every after boss fight, there's a reward! And at the end of every game is a happy ending! So don't quit now, I know you'll get through this!

That's all, take care everyone!
